Go-Daigo's 1331 revolt and ensuing factional struggles, incl. defecting shogunal vassals such as Ashikaga Takauji, destroyed the bakufu in 1333; the court restored direct imperial rule (Kemmu). All actors internal. Bakufu seat was Kamakura, not Kyoto.
